FAFO.

text:
Democrats: PAY ATTENTION TO SOUTH CAROLINA.

Dr. Jermaine Johnson is TWO POINTS away from flipping the governor’s office for the first time in more than 20 years.

Trump and MAGA are attacking voting rights because they know what happens when people show up — and they’re scared.

TAKE IT BACK! ⬇️

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is trying to make it harder for Americans to vote by mail ahead of the midterms.

California is taking him to court.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
The United States in 2026:

- Spend your week's wages to buy groceries.
- Get salmonella poisoning from the food you bought.
- Go to the doctor without insurance.
- In debt for the rest of your life.

But, you know, MAHA.

text:
Trump bought stock in Elon Musk’s SpaceX… a federal contractor regulated by his own administration.

One. Big. Grift.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
NEW: Following today’s SCOTUS ruling, California WILL SUE again to BLOCK Trump’s attack on mail-in voting!

Every eligible voter gets a mail-in ballot here — and we’ll fight to keep it that way.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Another day, another Trump attempt to rig elections and destroy democracy.

We can stop this. VOTE this November.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Apparently alienating Canada with 50% tariffs wasn’t enough. Now we’re mocking them too. Brilliant strategy, guys.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
California put FREE college and career savings accounts in the hands of our kids.

Now 1 MILLION families have claimed them — and more than $82 MILLION has already gone directly toward education and career training.

Washington is now following California’s lead. Good. Investing in our kids shouldn’t be partisan.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Our closest ally. Our critical trading partner.

And Trump is hitting Canada with 50% tariffs.

What the actual fuck are we doing?

author: GavinNewsom
text: Same idiot calling Democrats “communists,” by the way.

author: GavinNewsom
text: .@seanhannity, surely you’re covering this tonight, right?

author: GavinNewsom
text:
California is doing what NO state has ever done before — making our OWN prescription drugs to take on Big Pharma and drive down costs.

Insulin, naloxone, and asthma inhalers. EpiPens are next.

We’re making lifesaving drugs CHEAPER and more accessible for everyone.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
BIG NEWS! California will now be the first state to provide ALL of our 10,000 public and charter schools with FREE emergency-use asthma inhalers.

No child should be left gasping for air because their school doesn’t have an inhaler.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
A year of pre-school can cost families thousands. In California, we made it FREE.

Every 4-year-old now has access to a FULL YEAR of pre-K, saving families $13,000 A YEAR.

More money back in parents’ pockets, more opportunity for our kids.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
California has made BIG investments in our kids.

We created FREE pre-K for every 4-year-old.

We serve nearly ONE BILLION free school meals every year.

We expanded FREE before-school, after-school and summer programs.

We even created FREE college & career savings accounts for millions of kids. 

And we’re seeing the results: Student achievement is up across every grade and every student group.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump has turned the presidency into the greatest grift in American history.

It’s madness, and everyone around him is complicit.

author: GavinNewsom
text: SCOTUS agrees: Trump is a sexual abuser.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Thinking of the people across Gary and Northwest Indiana after the devastating storms that tore through the region.

The images of destruction are heartbreaking. Our thoughts are with the families who lost homes and the first responders working around the clock. 

California stands ready to help in any way.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
5,000 American sailors and Marines are being forced to remain at sea for Donald Trump’s reckless war with Iran.

Their families are sounding the alarm.

He created this crisis and our service members are paying the price.

End this failed war and bring them home.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump wants to put America in reverse.

We know what’s at stake and we have to meet this moment.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Detroit and Los Angeles have a lot in common — cities defined by resilience, reinvention, and generations of Black and Brown leadership. And both have been targeted by Donald Trump because of it.

Grateful to sit down with Black leaders to talk about building economic power and protecting our fundamental rights.

Thank you @MsMarySheffield and @RevSheffield for bringing us together and for the warm welcome.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Being against Donald Trump is not a governing agenda.

We need to show people what we’re FOR. A positive vision for the future where everyone has a stake and a shot.

That work starts now.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Twenty states still have a $7.25 minimum wage while an entire generation feels locked out of the economy.

Something is fundamentally broken.

Democrats should be the party willing to say it — and bold enough to fix it.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Silicon Valley and Detroit aren’t as far apart as you think.

Blue collar. White collar. Workers across this country are beginning to confront the same challenges as jobs are shipped overseas and replaced by automation. 

There’s a new coalition emerging — and it’s the path back to power for Democrats.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
America isn’t left vs. right. It’s top vs. bottom.

There is too much money and power concentrated in too few hands.

This is the fight that unites people — and the Democratic Party.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Democrats were ruthless last year — from passing Prop 50 in California to electing a Democratic governor in Virginia. We need to be ruthless again.

We’re flipping seats from red to blue across the country. KEEP FIGHTING!

We’re going to make history in November.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Donald Trump is doing everything he can to rig the midterms. But he’s a lame duck president — if we show up and vote up and down the ballot.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
The road back to the majority for Democrats isn’t through caution or capitulation.

It’s through the fight.

Voters want fighters. It’s time for Democrats to fight like hell.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
For decades, Fellowship Chapel has been a pillar of Detroit — a place where faith has matched action.

Under Reverend Dr. Wendell Anthony’s leadership, this congregation has carried forward the tradition of civil rights advocacy and community empowerment.

Honored to worship with this extraordinary congregation today, and grateful for the warm welcome.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
This is how democracies rot.

In the dead of night, the MAGA-controlled Senate bent the knee again — confirming Trump’s personal attorney as Attorney General.

This is corruption on a staggering scale. There must be accountability — and reforms to ensure a lawless DOJ can NEVER happen again.

Donald Trump and MAGA are rigging maps, erasing districts, and rewriting the rules to silence Black voters and diverse communities.

VOTE THIS NOVEMBER!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
California serves nearly ONE BILLION free school meals to kids each year.

I was proud to sign universal school meals into law, making us the first state to guarantee free breakfast and lunch to every public school student.

No child should have to learn on an empty stomach.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Congratulations @AbdulElSayed on a hard-fought victory! 

Trump and the GOP are trying everything to rig the rules and silence voters — but they can’t stop a Democratic Party united around working people and accountability.

On to November! Let’s take our country back.

text: Trump was just fundraising in a “blue state” he calls a “threat” — our “blue state” and “blue cities” are keeping “his” government afloat right now.

text:
Congratulations @JocelynBenson!

Taking on tough fights, delivering for Michiganders — that's exactly the kind of leadership this moment demands.

Let's send her to the governor's office.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is in California today for a fundraiser at his golf course.

But he still REFUSES to deliver the federal wildfire disaster aid he promised to Los Angeles wildfire survivors.

Instead, we've watched a presidency defined by corruption, self-dealing, and family enrichment at the expense of the American people.

California keeps America running. We send far more to Washington than we get back.

Stop stiffing Californians, Mr. President. Keep your word.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Congress is dead.

MAGA has a king.

Republicans killed the Constitution.

If we don’t win in November, democracy in America is over.

text:
California is raising the minimum wage to $17.40 an hour next year — more than DOUBLE the federal minimum wage.

Donald Trump and the GOP are still defending a $7.25 minimum wage while workers scrape by.

Pitiful.
